subject: Request to confirm continuous 95°C duty
symptoms: Customer asked whether new HX-240 units could run continuously at 95°C using standard seals.
diagnosis: Pump body is rated for 95°C continuous duty, but standard EPDM seal guidance is 90°C continuous.
resolution: Recommended FKM seal option and Application Engineering review of water chemistry before final confirmation.
service_lesson: Differentiate pump-body limit from seal-material limit in customer responses.
